thread:
Mira Patel: Heads-up — dropping 3 copy variants for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages. Need quick triage before next week's launch posts + webinar. TL;DR: Hosted = speed & easy onboarding; Dedicated = predictable throughput and committed capacity; Private = audit-ready, VPC/KMS. Drafts uploaded: https://drive.google.com/mock-link :link:  
Ben Liu: Got it. Can we attach a short benchmark narrative to each variant? e.g. Hosted -> 'fastest time-to-value', Dedicated -> 'predictable p99 & throughput', Private -> 'compliance + data control'. That will help social + blog hooks.
Olivia Chen: CTA idea: Hosted — 'Get API key' (self-serve); Dedicated — 'Request capacity'; Private — 'Request demo'. Also inbound routing should map to different lead queues so AEs get the right context.
Sam Ortiz: I sketched a routing map — see below:
```
/hosted -> marketing-plg?utm_campaign=launch_posts
/dedicated -> sales-dedicated (forms -> ask expected qps)
/private -> sales-enterprise (route to compliance AE)
/webinar -> nurture-webinar-2026
```
Would that cover it?
John Park: Prefer the Dedicated form to include 'expected QPS' and 'model types' so we can pre-qualify. Also add a quick budget checkbox for enterprise routing.
Olivia Chen: :thumbsup: And add a one-line onboarding checklist link in the Dedicated microcopy (helps conversion once AE engages).
Mira Patel: For launch cadence: Day 0 — hero post + short benchmark thread (latency/cost highlight), Day 2 — deep-dive blog on Dedicated economics and sizing, Day 4 — webinar (panel: infra + product + sales). Need social hooks for each variant. Who owns benchmarks? :rocket:
Ben Liu: I can pull token/sec, p95/p99 latency, and cost-per-1k-tokens from infra dashboards. Suggest baseline comparisons against an open-medium model and a quantized variant. Will sketch graphs.
Olivia Chen: Webinar title idea: "Serving LLMs at scale: predictable latency, cost, and ops". Panelists: infra eng, product PM, solutions AE. Also add a gating question "Compliance required?" to route registrants to Private sales.
Sam Ortiz: Marketing will host the reg form. Proposed gate questions: org size, deployment preference (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), expected traffic, compliance need. We'll map answers to SFDC queues.
John Park: For Private route add checkbox 'requires on-prem / air-gapped' to tag tickets appropriately.
Mira Patel: Action items (quick):
- Ben Liu: benchmark graphs + 3-line blurb (due Tue)
- Olivia Chen: finalize CTA microcopy + form questions (due Tue)
- Sam Ortiz: routing rules + SFDC mapping doc (due Wed)
- Marketing: social copy drafts for Day 0/2/4 (due Thu)
I'll open the landing-copy PR once we lock the CTAs.
Olivia Chen: One micro tweak: avoid using just 'Private' as the label on public pages — use 'Private deployment (VPC / on‑prem)' to reduce confusion.
Ben Liu: Noted. I'll annotate Hosted copy with burst capacity notes and Dedicated with commit sizing guidance.
Mira Patel: Thanks all — scheduling a 30m async review tomorrow. Ping me directly if anything blocks.
